predictor.notes: Best-supported predictor: three all-units pricing tiers, in pence. It matches all 10 exact observations with zero error: the two approvals and all eight permitted distinct estimates. Each tier has at least three observations with identical price per unit; interval fitting supports these coefficients with or without allowing intercepts. Transition locations remain unresolved. Assuming this three-tier structure, the second tier starts somewhere in inclusive [201,275], and the third somewhere in [564,625]. Returned starts 238 and 595 are midpoint estimates, not verified breakpoints. Under that structure, tier assignment is uncertain only at quantities 201–274 and 564–624. The distinct-estimate cap is exhausted; repeats and the available approvals cannot narrow these gaps. Exact reconstruction over all 1–1000 quantities is therefore not established, and unobserved nonlinearities or additional transitions cannot be excluded.
